description:
Tray sidekick for Claude Code — usage tracking, session browser, quick launchers, prompt library.

Claude Sessions Sidekick is a Windows tray utility that complements Anthropic's Claude Code CLI.
It provides a persistent at-a-glance view of usage limits (5-hour rolling block and weekly
Sonnet/Opus utilization), a searchable browser for past Claude Code sessions across projects
with per-session notes and color tags, project quick launchers with global hotkeys, a reusable
prompt library, and an MCP server browser.

The app reads only local Claude Code data and uses the user's own OAuth token for the official
Claude Code usage API — no telemetry, no third-party servers.
Added
- Reset times in the status line. Two new blocks in the status line
  builder: {5h_reset} shows when the 5-hour limit resets (14:30) and
  {7d_reset} when the weekly limit resets (Sat 22:00), in local time.
  The "With usage limits" preset now shows the weekly reset time in brackets.
Fixed
- Copy reply picked the wrong session after /rename. With two sessions of
  one repo open in Windows Terminal, the terminal title shows the name given
  with /rename, which Sidekick only read for its log and never matched
  against the title, so the newest session won. The name from Claude Code's
  own session record now counts when matching the title.
